item.title: Morocco Caps E-Scooters at 25 km/h and Hands Vehicle Paperwork to a New Safety Agency
item.description: This issue of Morocco’s Official Gazette rewrites road-safety rules for e-scooters and drivers, shifts vehicle registration to a new agency, and clears land for a dam, two drinking-water projects, a port expansion and a highway widening.

item.title: Morocco Overhauls the Legal Profession, Makes Impersonating a Lawyer a Prison Offense
item.description: A new law rewrites the rules for who can practice law in Morocco and criminalizes impersonating a lawyer, alongside a judicial appointments fix and a Settat water project.
